title: Renewal Storyline and Deck Compose Kit
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, composable kit for building QBR/renewal decks that can be assembled for: standard accounts (self-serve / mid-market) and enterprise accounts (SLA, security, multi-stakeholder). Aim is to reduce deck build time and improve consistency of renewal narratives across CSMs and AMs.

How to use this kit (quick):
- Pick a storyline lens (Adoption, ROI, Risk-to-Expansion).
- Select the slide modules for Standard vs Enterprise.
- Fill the account-specific metrics block and the 90-day plan template.
- Attach the renewal timeline + decision-map (1-pg).

Module library (slide-by-slide building blocks):
1) Cover + TL;DR (1 slide)
   - Title: [Account] QBR — Health & Renewal Snapshot
   - Subtitle: Meeting owner + date + ask (renewal window)
   - Speaker note: 30s exec intro: who we are, goal of call (align on outcomes + renewal next steps)

2) Executive Snapshot (1 slide) — Standard + Enterprise variants
   - Standard: 3 bullets: Health score, usage delta, key wins
   - Enterprise: Add: contractual renewal date, primary risk, escalations & next steps
   - Speaker note: Lead with ROI headline (cost avoided or value unlocked). Keep <90s.

3) Usage & Adoption (2 slides)
   - Slide A: Weekly active users / API calls / peak latency by route (sparkline)
   - Slide B: Feature adoption heatmap (embeddings vs chat vs reranking) + power users list
   - Enterprise addon: Data residency / VPC usage status and recent audit items

4) Value Realized (1–2 slides)
   - Sourced wins: 3 customer-provided outcomes mapped to KPIs (revenue, CSAT, time-saved)
   - Calculation box: simple before/after metric (e.g., 30% faster triage, $X/month saved)
   - Tip: call out measurable experiments we ran and their impact windows

5) Quality & Risk (1 slide)
   - Error rates, latency SLO attainment, incident highlights (last 90 days)
   - Enterprise variant: open compliance tickets, audit timeline, PoA (plan-of-action) owner

6) Cost & Efficiency (1 slide)
   - Current bill runway, 90-day forecast with proposed optimizations (batching / quantization)
   - Suggested ask: small pilot of Redwood Optimize settings -> estimated savings %

7) Roadmap & Product Requests (1 slide)
   - Near-term features affecting account, expected delivery windows
   - Custom work requests + rough effort estimate (S/M/L)

8) Ask and Renewal Motion (1 slide)
   - Renewal window, recommended package (Standard vs Dedicated vs Private), proposed price band
   - Activation milestones for renewal: 30/60/90 day checklist
   - Enterprise variant: Legal / Security review owners and estimated sign-off dates

9) 90-Day Joint Plan (1 slide)
   - Clear owner/responsibility table (CSM, Eng SE, Customer Owner)
   - Measurable outcomes tied to renewal (X adoption, Y SLA, Z security tasks)

10) Appendix (multiple slides)
   - Technical appendix: latency distributions, model variants used, KV cache hit rates
   - Contract appendix: current SKU mapping, overage history, committed spend vs usage

Assembly rules and voice: 
- Keep language outcome-forward ("improved accuracy" -> what that means in business terms).
- Use the Standard deck for accounts with <$50k ARR and simple renewal. Use Enterprise variant for strategic accounts with multi-team stakeholders.
- Default template length: 10–14 slides. Executive TL;DR must fit 3 bullets.

Speaker note examples (drop-in):
- Adoption opener: "Over the last quarter your usage has grown X% across the embeddings route — that correlates with the new search experience we shipped in Feb."
- Risk callout: "We saw 2 incidents impacting latency for route /chat-large — our recommended mitigation is increasing the KV cache retention for session-based flows."

Quick renewal tracker (paste into customer sheet) — single-row representation for deck prep: 
- Account | Renewal Date | Recommended SKU | RAG | Primary Stakeholder | Legal Status | Next Meeting
- Example: "Acme Co | 2026-01-15 | Dedicated-4GPU | Amber | Sarah Patel (Head ML) | Review in progress | 2025-11-20"

One-page decision map (text flow for slide):
- If Legal asks for SOC2 + data locality -> propose Private (VPC) eval + 4-week audit plan
- If cost sensitivity only -> propose Optimize pilot (3-week) + projected savings table
- If performance SLA is primary -> propose Dedicated with canary traffic test + baseline latency report

Enterprise customization checklist (for CSMs handling renewals > $250k ARR):
- Pre-call: confirm all stakeholders, pull audit logs, run a custom eval on their production prompt set
- Security: attach redlined security addendum draft if needed
- Commercial: prepare 2 pricing bands (conservative & aspirational) and an internal fallback price
- Exec prep: 1-pg one-liner for CRO/Head of Sales, estimated pipeline impact of renewal

Templates & copy snippets (drop-ins):
- "Outcome headline" — "[Customer] reduced mean time to resolution by X% after integrating Redwood routes into triage flow."
- "Close ask" — "We recommend renewing on Dedicated-2 for predictable throughput; we can include a 60-day rollback safety clause."

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self, CSMs):
- Confirm whether customer requires contract language for on-prem keys.
- Ask product for short latency report that isolates peak-hour percentiles.
- (Optional) run a 2-week Optimize pilot and include results in executive snapshot.

Appendix: quick pasteable slide text (one-liners)
- Cover TL;DR: "Renewal goal: align on outcomes + close by 2026-01-15. Current health: Good. Risk: security review pending."
- 90-Day Plan bullets: "1) Enable dedicated routing for search by Dec 1. 2) Run Optimize pilot Dec 5–19. 3) Legal sign-off by Dec 20."

Change log / authorship notes:
- 2025-11-03: initial draft by Maya Chen (CSM playbooks).
- 2025-12-12: added enterprise checklist and decision map (Diego Morales).
- 2026-02-12: updated cost/efficiency language and sample tracker (Priya Singh).

Useful links / references (placeholders):
- Confluence: Renewal Playbooks hub -> CONFLUENCE-3242
- Jira epic: JIRA-CS-781 (enterprise renewal experiments)
- Deck sample: github.com/redwood-inference/renewal-decks/sample-enterprise-deck

Notes on format and examples: keep this doc as the single source of truth for deck modules. CSMs should copy modules into their customer decks and track the decision map in the customer renewal row in the tracker sheet.

-- end of kit --
